title: Wilted Dreams
summary: Drink to take 3d6 Psychic damage at your next Long Rest.

fields.Wilted Dreams: A single-use potion. The effect deals 3d6 Psychic damage during your next Long Rest.
fields.Inspiration: Drinking it grants An Acquired Taste to Guild Artisan party members.
fields.Acquisition: Acrid Workshop at the end of the Overgrown Tunnel.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay details with pinned item and linked rules evidence.
